description: Create and revise short explainer videos and slides in your Fablyn workspace. Describe what you want to explain, then use Fablyn to save a Video, check its stills, and refine the words, layout and motion. Add optional narration and render a finished video, or approve stills as slides. Review your work and manage approvals in Fablyn Studio. A Fablyn account is required. Narration and rendering use your workspace’s minutes.

defaultPrompt: Create a silent three-step Video explaining how to prepare for a customer meeting. Save a draft in Fablyn for me to review.
Show the Videos in my Fablyn workspace that have open notes, then help me choose which one to revise.
Create three slides explaining weekly planning. Make the stills so I can review them in Fablyn before approval.
